steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Well, now I understand why you said that even though Robin joined the team, it wasn't that simple.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Looks like Jesselton talked her over, and she joined Anthony's side as a spy.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: And here I thought there wasn't gonna be any more surprises in the story.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I didn't know that Robin'd been through all that. Not even the intel I read mentioned it.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: And Jesselton. I'd heard about him, but I didn't know he could be this difficult to deal with.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You know about him?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: He's one of Parasol's ace hatchet men, and I heard that as long as you've got the money, he's more than willing to be your errand boy. He's HydeBro's top trump card for this whole kerfuffle.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Known to have a dainty fine taste, but most people just think he's beyond repulsive.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I thought he was just some normal hitman, but who knew he was such a thinker.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I knew he was HydeBro's trump card, but I didn't expect him to make a snap decision like that.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: He made it seem like he gave her a choice, but she actually didn't have much of a choice.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It's just exactly as he said, though. He had information on Robin's background that Anthony didn't have.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: What's more, he'd been watching Anthony the whole time without him knowing. It's no wonder he had the advantage.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: If I were in her shoes, faced with that kinda predicament, I would've picked his side too.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Oh, I thought you would disagree.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I don't agree with the way he thinks, and I don't like him.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But, at the very least, I think what he said to Robin was at least more forthcoming than you trying to test me over and over.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: How you talk like you know who I am makes you just as repulsive as my mentor, Director Muelsyse.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Looks like I went a little overboard. Guess I should apologize.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: To tell you the truth, even I feel the same way about him. He's kinda boring.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It's not easy to find someone like Robin if you don't go out of your way. Someone who has a complicated relationship with Anthony.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: And to bait her into the game like that...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Well, whatever. In any case, we have all the players in the jailbreak party by now, right?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: We've got a pretty smooth informant, an assassin who's not half bad, a girl working part-time who gets to go anywhere she wants in the prison, a morgue doctor who's been there for ages, and an excellent leader...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It's pretty well-rounded for a ragtag team.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Right, long story short, after all the groundwork was laid, they more or less moved on to a preparatory phase. It almost went without a hitch.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Did anything happen during that time?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Nothing other than the assassinations.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Oh, right, I almost forgot. The hit was still on, wasn't it?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Yes, but since the jailers had no way to handle it other than looking into all the prisoners, and the hitmen were only going after Anthony, they gave up on doing anything about it.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Aha, that's just like them.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Oh, I just remembered something Robin told me.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: That thing about how they convinced Domma to leave with them!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Huh? What's this about? I thought Domma was part of the team?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Oh, that's right. They didn't find out until later that even though Domma said she'd help Anthony break out of prison, she didn't intend to leave herself.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Why is that?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Because she hadn't ever been outside the prison.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: You heard me right. I ain't actually goin' with you.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: How come? Don't tell me you actually like it here.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: No, I don't like it here. Not one bit.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: The last morgue doctor took me in when the prison was docked. Far back as I'n remember, I only ever lived here. This is where I grew up.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: The patronizin' jailers, the hate, the inmate violence. Their deaths, too. That's all I ever seen in my life.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: I sometimes take a walk around outside when we pop into a city. I'n tell I don't belong there.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: I'm... scared.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Then why're you helping Anthony break out of this place?

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: cause he's my only friend.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: It wasn't until Anthony got here that I knew there were people like him in the world.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: He gets into scraps like the others, but he got some self-control.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: He gets angry, but he don't let his anger make trouble for nobody.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: He's always polite, downright fair to everyone.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: He pushes books on me, and tells me what life's like on the outside.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: When he first got here, he'd belly-ache 'bout how fate's unkind to him. I's already thinkin' of helpin' him get out back then.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: But I don't know anything, and I wasn't being much of a help to him. So I didn't say nothin'.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Then he started gettin' calmer and calmer, 'n' everyone else started lookin' up to him. I's happy and a little sad at the same time.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Felt like he was missin' something.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: sides, I always thought that he shouldn'ta been locked up in here. He shoulda had a better life.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: That's why I's awful happy for him when he decided to leave after Kafka spilled the beans to him.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: And just helpin' him get out is more'n I need.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Don't say nothin' to him, but I'm ready. If somethin' goes wrong somewhere, I'm more'n willin' to give my life just to see him out of here.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: This isn't right.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Whassa matter, Robin? You don't look too good.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I'm just thinking. You're really willing to go so far for him?

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I don't think that's a good thing, though.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: You're right. Life on the outside's a lot more complicated than life in here.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: It's not all sunshine and rainbows outside, either. There're probably more bad things out there than good.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: But I also think... it's a shame if you don't try to live all that just because you're scared.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: You don't think Anthony belongs in prison.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: But I think someone kind-hearted as you doesn't belong here either.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: You deserve a better life.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Do I?

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: I dunno.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: And I'm pretty sure he'd think just the same way about you too.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: He wants a better life for you.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Let me think about it, okay?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Yeah.
